items.title: Harmeet Dhillon, who runs the Justice Department’s Civil Rights division, resigns
items.brief: Harmeet Dhillon has resigned from her post as the head of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, making her the first senior official to leave the administration since the midterms.

items.title: President of Paraguay resigns amid crisis over bank collapse that left millions unable to access their money
items.brief: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned from office this Thursday after Ueno Bank was shut down in the middle of the night due to a solvency crisis, leaving millions of customers unable to access their money and…

items.title: The awkward ending to Cristiano Ronaldo’s extraordinary Portugal career
items.brief: During the five minutes it took to watch Cristiano Ronaldo ’s emotional farewell video to the Portuguese national team, it was easy to forget the sour note on which his international career has ended.

items.title: Postal worker accused of shooting 2 co-workers at Des Moines post office, police say
items.brief: A US Postal Service employee is in custody on suspicion of shooting two co-workers at a large post office near downtown Des Moines, Iowa, on Thursday morning, police said.

items.title: Bomb threats have disrupted more than 20 flights across Europe this week. Here’s what we know
items.brief: More than 20 flights across Europe have been impacted by a string of hoax bomb threats this week, disrupting travel plans and in some cases forcing countries to scramble fighter jets.

items.title: LIV Golf winding down operations, lawyer says in bankruptcy hearing
items.brief: LIV Golf is winding down operations instead of launching a new version because of a lack of financial support.

items.title: Winning ticket drawn in New Jersey for $847 million Powerball jackpot
items.brief: A single Powerball ticket in New Jersey has won an estimated $847 million after matching all six numbers in Wednesday’s drawing, the company said Thursday.

items.title: 1 killed and 2 hurt in small helicopter crash off Miami, officials say
